name: Shannon Bray
incumbencyStatus: perennial Libertarian candidate (4th statewide race since 2020)

priorRoles: Worked for Visa, Microsoft, and federal government agencies
biography.education: Master's degree in cybersecurity from University of Delaware
biography.background: Based in Apex, NC. Cybersecurity specialist with experience at Visa, Microsoft, and federal agencies. Navy veteran (1991-1997). Has run for statewide office four times since 2020. Author of 'Liberty Unleashed.' Unusually well-documented Libertarian candidate with a detailed campaign website, book, multiple structured interviews, and voter guide questionnaire responses.

statedPositions.notes: Consistent across all four campaign cycles. Detailed in his book 'Liberty Unleashed.' Extreme Pole B position.
Explicit plan to phase out Social Security. Extreme Pole B position.
Consistent across all cycles. Opposes government subsidies and industrial policy.
Supports school choice, vouchers, and competition. LPNC platform alignment.

statedPositions.quote: Repeal ACA, HSAs as primary mechanism
statedPositions.notes: Explicit ACA repeal position. Health savings accounts and patient data ownership approach.

statedPositions.quote: No price controls; patient data ownership approach
statedPositions.notes: No explicit price control position but opposes government intervention in healthcare markets.
Strong individual choice framing on public health mandates.
Has dedicated policy page on guns. Supports repealing existing gun regulations.

statedPositions.quote: Abolish qualified immunity, end civil asset forfeiture, ban no-knock warrants
statedPositions.notes: BallotReady 2024 questionnaire responses. Strong Pole A police accountability position — notable contrast with economic positions.

statedPositions.quote: Drug legalization, abolish federal death penalty
statedPositions.notes: Supports full drug legalization and abolishing the federal death penalty. Strong Pole A rehabilitation/liberty position.

statedPositions.quote: Ban carbon taxes, slash energy regulations
statedPositions.notes: Explicit opposition to carbon taxes and energy regulation. Pole B position.
Has dedicated energy/utilities policy page. Supports nuclear power, opposes subsidies for clean energy.

statedPositions.notes: Inferred from consistent deregulation philosophy. No specific permitting statement.

crossAxisPattern.note: Shannon Bray presents an unusual cross-axis pattern that is internally consistent for a libertarian but distinctive in the matching system. His economic/tax positions are extreme Pole B (abolish IRS, phase out Social Security, kill the Fed). His justice positions on policing and sentencing are Pole A (abolish qualified immunity, drug legalization, abolish federal death penalty). This libertarian scatter will create unique matching patterns — he won't match cleanly with either typical 'left' or 'right' user profiles.

evidenceSummary.notes: Shannon Bray is unusually well-documented for a third-party candidate due to four statewide campaigns, a book, detailed policy pages, and multiple voter guide responses. Most axes can be scored with HIGH confidence. The libertarian cross-axis pattern (extreme Pole B economics + Pole A justice reform) is distinctive and well-supported by evidence.
